brief.en: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access to systems, typically containing malicious attachments or links.
brief.pt: Adversários podem enviar mensagens de phishing para obter acesso a sistemas, geralmente contendo anexos ou links maliciosos.
brief.de: Angreifer können Phishing-Nachrichten versenden, um sich Zugriff auf Systeme zu verschaffen, typischerweise mit bösartigen Anhängen oder Links.

what_it_means.en: Indicates the receipt of a message (usually email) designed to deceive the recipient and gain initial access or credentials.
what_it_means.pt: Indica o recebimento de uma mensagem (geralmente e-mail) projetada para enganar o destinatário e obter acesso inicial ou credenciais.
what_it_means.de: Zeigt den Empfang einer Nachricht (in der Regel E-Mail) an, die darauf ausgelegt ist, den Empfänger zu täuschen und Erstzugriff oder Anmeldedaten zu erlangen.

why_it_matters.en: It is one of the most common initial access vectors, since it exploits the human factor rather than a technical vulnerability.
why_it_matters.pt: É um dos vetores de acesso inicial mais comuns, pois explora o fator humano em vez de vulnerabilidades técnicas.
why_it_matters.de: Es ist einer der häufigsten Erstzugriffsvektoren, da es den menschlichen Faktor statt einer technischen Schwachstelle ausnutzt.

en: Sender or origin domain inconsistent with the claimed sender
Attachment with a macro, script, or disguised executable extension
Link to a recently registered domain or one visually similar to a legitimate service
Language creating urgency or an unusual appeal for the recipient's context
pt: Remetente ou domínio de origem inconsistente com o suposto emissor
Anexo com macro, script ou extensão executável disfarçada
Link para domínio recém-registrado ou visualmente similar a um serviço legítimo
Linguagem de urgência ou apelo incomum para o contexto do destinatário
de: Absender oder Ursprungsdomain stimmt nicht mit dem angegebenen Absender überein
Anhang mit Makro, Skript oder getarnter ausführbarer Erweiterung
Link zu einer kürzlich registrierten oder einem legitimen Dienst optisch ähnlichen Domain
Sprache, die Dringlichkeit oder einen ungewöhnlichen Reiz für den Kontext des Empfängers erzeugt

en: Legitimate communication from a known partner or vendor, just misclassified by filters
Authorized phishing simulation run by the security team (training)
pt: Comunicação legítima de parceiro ou fornecedor conhecido, apenas mal classificada por filtros
Simulação de phishing autorizada pela equipe de segurança (treinamento)
de: Legitime Kommunikation eines bekannten Partners oder Anbieters, nur von Filtern falsch eingestuft

en: Analyzing only the email content without technically checking attachments/links
Not correlating the email with the recipient's subsequent activity
Assuming the user did not interact with the email without confirming it
pt: Analisar apenas o conteúdo do e-mail sem verificar anexos/links tecnicamente
Não correlacionar o e-mail com a atividade subsequente do usuário que o recebeu
Assumir que o usuário não interagiu com o e-mail sem confirmar
de: Nur den E-Mail-Inhalt zu analysieren, ohne Anhänge/Links technisch zu prüfen
Die E-Mail nicht mit der anschließenden Aktivität des Empfängers zu korrelieren
Ohne Bestätigung anzunehmen, dass der Benutzer nicht mit der E-Mail interagiert hat

description.en: Identifies unusual inbound email with attachments or URLs followed by new process execution or suspicious document behavior.
description.pt: Identifica e-mails de entrada incomuns com anexos ou URLs seguidos de execução de novo processo ou comportamento suspeito de documento.
description.de: Identifiziert ungewöhnliche eingehende E-Mails mit Anhängen oder URLs, gefolgt von neuer Prozessausführung oder verdächtigem Dokumentverhalten.

logSources.name: m365:unified
logSources.channel: Send/Receive: Emails with suspicious sender domains, spoofed headers, or anomalous attachment types

mutableElements.description: Attachment types considered high risk (e.g., .exe, .js, .vbs, .scr, macro-enabled docs).
Whitelist of known trusted senders to reduce false positives.

description.en: Detects malicious payload delivery through email clients (Thunderbird, mutt) resulting in suspicious file creation or outbound connections.
description.pt: Detecta entrega de payload malicioso por meio de clientes de e-mail (Thunderbird, mutt) resultando em criação de arquivo suspeito ou conexões de saída.
description.de: Erkennt bösartige Payload-Zustellung über E-Mail-Clients (Thunderbird, mutt), die zu verdächtiger Dateierstellung oder ausgehenden Verbindungen führt.

logSources.name: Application:Mail
logSources.channel: Inbound messages with anomalous headers, spoofed SPF/DKIM failures

logSources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
logSources.channel: execve: Execution of scripts or binaries sourced from mail directories (/var/mail, ~/Maildir)

mutableElements.description: System or user directories where emails/attachments are stored.
Known good hashes for common business document templates.

description.en: Identifies anomalous Mail app activity such as attachments executed immediately or URLs launched via Safari/Preview (macOS).
description.pt: Identifica atividade anômala do app Mail, como anexos executados imediatamente ou URLs abertas via Safari/Preview (macOS).
description.de: Identifiziert anomale Mail-App-Aktivität wie sofort ausgeführte Anhänge oder über Safari/Preview geöffnete URLs (macOS).

logSources.name: macos:unifiedlog
logSources.channel: Inbound email activity with suspicious domains or mismatched sender information

logSources.name: macos:unifiedlog
logSources.channel: Preview.app, Safari.app, or Mail.app spawning new processes outside normal patterns

mutableElements.description: List of domains known for phishing activity or suspicious sender infrastructure.
Time threshold between file save and execution considered suspicious.

description.en: Detects phishing via Office documents with embedded macros or links spawning processes.
description.pt: Detecta phishing via documentos Office com macros incorporadas ou links que iniciam processos.
description.de: Erkennt Phishing über Office-Dokumente mit eingebetteten Makros oder Links, die Prozesse starten.

logSources.name: m365:unified
logSources.channel: FileAccessed: Access of email attachments by Office applications

mutableElements.description: Parent processes expected to execute child processes (e.g., Office apps).
Threshold for number of macros executed before raising alerts.

description.en: Identifies phishing targeting identity providers manifesting as anomalous login attempts and fake SSO prompts.
description.pt: Identifica phishing direcionado a provedores de identidade, manifestando-se como tentativas de login anômalas e prompts falsos de SSO.
description.de: Identifiziert Phishing gegen Identitätsanbieter, das sich als anomale Anmeldeversuche und gefälschte SSO-Aufforderungen zeigt.

logSources.name: azure:signinlogs
logSources.channel: Failed MFA attempts, unusual conditional access triggers, login attempts from unexpected IP ranges

mutableElements.description: Allowed distance/time delta between user sign-ins.
Signals of repeated or anomalous MFA failures linked to phishing campaigns.

description.en: Detects phishing via SaaS services (chat, collaboration platforms) with malicious URLs or attachments.
description.pt: Detecta phishing via serviços SaaS (chat, plataformas de colaboração) com URLs ou anexos maliciosos.
description.de: Erkennt Phishing über SaaS-Dienste (Chat, Kollaborationsplattformen) mit bösartigen URLs oder Anhängen.

logSources.name: saas:collaboration
logSources.channel: MessagePosted: Suspicious links or attachment delivery via collaboration tools (Slack, Teams, Zoom)

mutableElements.description: Scope of SaaS platforms under phishing monitoring.
Threshold for auto-expansion and detonation of URLs sent in SaaS messages.
